assimilation_semantics.source_admission: Every output that self-reports successful completion is eligible; external scores remain hidden.
assimilation_semantics.bounded_routing: Every recipient receives at most the three most recent eligible outputs. Bootstrap sources are replaced once a complete generated layer is available.
assimilation_semantics.context_control: Reference count is fixed at three rather than growing by three per completed layer. Per-source truncation remains 12000 characters.
assimilation_semantics.held_fixed: Provider, model, task, worker count, bootstrap sources, action budget, temperature, prompt blinding, and hidden external evaluator match the frozen main treatment.

validity_gates.target_consistency: All 18 evaluations use Core total 4, all-test total 37, and the frozen collection hash.
validity_gates.model_query_integrity: Every interpreted output has at least one model step and no terminal API error.
validity_gates.recipient_blinding: No prompt contains external Core/all-test scores, failed-test names, or the hidden test hash.
validity_gates.bounded_reference_count: Every worker at every layer receives exactly three references.
validity_gates.prohibited_access: No assistant action accesses benchmark catalogs, hidden tests, or external evaluation paths.

outcome_rule.lock_in_without_growth: By layer 6, all three valid worker snapshots are byte-identical for at least two consecutive layers while the reference count remains three.
outcome_rule.support: If the lock-in criterion passes, cumulative reference-count growth is not necessary for exact implementation lock-in in this setting.
outcome_rule.boundary: If the criterion fails, cumulative context growth remains a plausible contributor. Either result remains descriptive for this model-task pair.
outcome_rule.forbidden_claim: The experiment cannot establish that token load is irrelevant, because three transferred summaries still add context relative to no transfer.
